authority.legal_name: Auckland Transport (AT), the Auckland Council transport authority
authority.home_waters_label: the Waitematā Harbour and inner Hauraki Gulf

mandate.summary: Auckland Transport runs the city's integrated public-transport network, including roughly a dozen ferry routes across the Waitematā Harbour and Hauraki Gulf, ticketed through AT HOP and feeding the bus and rail network.
current_priorities: Integrating ferries into the AT HOP network
Decarbonizing the ferry fleet — first hybrid-electric ferries now in service
Supporting housing growth on the harbour fringe and islands

policy_targets.vision: Te Tāruke-ā-Tāwhiri: Auckland's Climate Plan / TERP
policy_targets.decarb_note: Auckland's TERP calls for a steep cut in transport emissions by 2030, and AT has begun introducing hybrid-electric ferries — but the diesel fleet still runs most of the harbour.
policy_targets.relevance: Navier is the zero-emission foiling upgrade to a network AT already runs and is already starting to electrify — faster harbour and Gulf commutes that relieve the Harbour Bridge while extending the electrification AT has begun.

precedent.headline: Public harbour ferries are core commuter infrastructure here, not a novelty.
precedent.network: Auckland Transport runs about 13 ferry routes from Downtown across the Waitematā and Hauraki Gulf, ticketed on AT HOP, and has introduced its first locally-built hybrid-electric ferries.
precedent.note: Public ferry service is core transport infrastructure here, not a novelty. Navier adds a fast passenger-only foiling layer on the busy corridors.

interpretation_for_navier: Navier is the zero-emission foiling upgrade to a network AT already runs and is already starting to electrify — faster harbour and Gulf commutes that relieve the Harbour Bridge while extending the electrification AT has begun.

domestic_network.note: Candidate boarding points with APPROXIMATE anchor coordinates [lng, lat] for Grok to snap to real piers/terminals during seal. Coordinates are anchors, not sealed geometry. Core mirrors the authority's live public stops; new/committed/study stops are flagged.

domestic_pairs.rationale: Eastern-suburbs commuter run across the Waitematā.
Upper-harbour commuter line to the fast-growing northwest.
North-shore line via Birkenhead and Northcote.

regional_links.note: Domestic-only network across the Waitematā Harbour and inner Hauraki Gulf. Outer-Gulf and Coromandel links are secondary and out of scope for this phase.

routing_hazards.instruction: Every domestic leg must be routed through navigable open water with NO land crossings (interior_land_km == 0). Hand-curated waypoints required wherever a breakwater, barrier, bridge pier, reef, headland, naval/exclusion zone or shallows would otherwise be clipped. Use data-clean/uae_hand_waypoints.json format {from, to, waypoints:[[lng,lat]...]}.

hazards.detail: Much of the Gulf is a marine park with marine-mammal protections — speed and wake limits and seasonal routing apply; flag legs crossing sanctuary zones.
The Waitematā shipping channel and Harbour Bridge piers sit in the route — waypoint clear and cross the channel at marked points.
The upper harbour (Hobsonville, Beach Haven) and eastern beaches have tidal sandbanks — follow the marked channels.
Downtown Ferry Basin is busy with multiple operators — low-wake, geofenced no-foil zones at the terminal.
